component.name: Dependency Tracker
component.summary: Watch project dependencies for new releases

description.p: Dependency Tracker scans the project manifests already on your disk, works out which packages they depend on, and watches those packages for new releases. Results are deduplicated across all of your local repositories, so a package used by six projects is tracked once rather than six times.
A loopback MCP server is included, letting coding agents query the same dependency data over the Model Context Protocol.
Adds a project page for the repository. No changes to the application.

Coming from an earlier development build on Linux: the application id changed, and login keyring entries are namespaced by it. Re-enter your GitHub token in Settings, and re-copy the MCP token into any agent that connects to this app — the token is regenerated, so an agent still sending the old one is refused. The watch database is unaffected.
